opportunities.title: Small grants

amount.raw: generally £1,500-£5,000; will only exceptionally exceed £6,000; travel up to £2,000 (≤13 days) or £2,500 (14+ days) per person; PhD fieldwork visits up to £5,000; Japan office up to ¥300,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution willing to receive grant funds. Applications not accepted from individuals for personal projects, though the UK office may consider individuals with proof of organisational support. Payments cannot be made to personal bank accounts. Previous recipients welcome.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding to enable UK-Japan projects that might otherwise not be possible, bringing people in the UK and Japan together to deepen mutual understanding, exchange ideas/expertise, or develop lasting collaboration. Supports festivals, workshops, performances, exchanges, collaborative projects, Japanese language teaching, and academic research/visits.

opportunities.title: Butterfield Awards in Medicine and Health

deadlines.raw: 1 December (annual, decision in March of following year)

amount.raw: up to £10,000; continuing projects up to three years to a maximum of £10,000 per year, total limit £30,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants should normally show an existing research record; consideration also given to practitioners, managers, carers or others in health-related fields. Preference to those not previously involved in UK-Japan collaboration; early-career applications particularly welcomed. Must involve partners in both UK and Japan, supported by reputable referees from different institutions.
opportunities.summary: Supports exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in Japan and the UK, including study of scientific, clinical, social and economic issues in healthcare. Creates opportunities for researchers, practitioners, policy makers, managers and voluntary sector workers to share knowledge and develop new approaches. Grants may be used for travel, conference and publication costs.
